page.layout: Only the front board of the binding: an outer border of tooled ornament, a framed central panel with a tooled figure scene, and a lower panel below it with a tooled band of lettering. Two metal clasps on the left edge. The library label and grey scale at the bottom are not part of the page.
page.notes: Binding, not a printed page. The front board carries blind-tooled decoration: a border of foliage and ornament, a central panel with a standing figure scene, and a lower band with a line of tooled lettering. That lettering is too faint to read, so it is not transcribed. Two metal clasps on the left edge. The Herzog August Bibliothek label, the scale and the digitiser's banner are excluded.
